title: Evaluating Machine Perception of Indigeneity: An Analysis of ChatGPT's Perceptions of Indigenous Roles in Diverse Scenarios
findings: The LLM strongly stereotyped Indigenous individuals by reinforcing tropes of deep nature connections, ancestral practices, and exoticized spiritual depictions, aligning with 'noble savage' and 'magical shaman' stereotypes.
